journey.name: Gaps common suggestions
journey.description: Verifies the Gaps tab shows common suggestions when no API key is configured, and that the common-suggestions banner opens the AI-locked sheet. Start state: fresh install with no API key configured.

actions.action: Tap the "GAPS" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Gaps screen shows the "What's missing" heading and a "Common Suggestions" banner.
Verify the "Unlock AI features" sheet is shown with a "Go to Settings" button.
Verify the app navigates to the Settings screen showing the "Settings" heading.
